transform_embedding_request: transform an OpenAI-format embedding request to Jina AI's /v1/embeddings request format
transform_embedding_response: transform a Jina AI embedding API response into a standardized EmbeddingResponse object
get_complete_url: build the complete Jina AI embeddings API URL from api_base and model parameters
validate_environment: validate and construct request headers with Content-Type and Bearer authorization for Jina AI
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI-compatible parameters for Jina AI embedding models
